<!--
Shows: the layout classes (ojs-row, ojs-grid, ojs-fill, ojs-auto, ojs-end,
a nested grid), every Observable Inputs control a panel restyles, a
controls bar of several sliders (ojs-chart-controls ojs-grid), and a slider
without the play button (data-vm-play="off").

  layout classes: https://apurvanakade.github.io/mathviz/docs/markup.html#panels
  data-vm-play:   https://apurvanakade.github.io/mathviz/docs/markup.html#data-vm-play
-->

Nothing here computes much: the page is a catalog of panel layouts. Resize the window to watch each one wrap.

```{ojs}
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

## A row: fill, auto, end

The first control fills the row; `ojs-fill` makes a text field a wide box the reader can drag wider, `ojs-auto` keeps a control at its natural width, and `ojs-end` pushes one to the right edge.

::: {.ojs-panel .ojs-row}
```{ojs}
viewof rowExpr = {
  const view = Inputs.text({label: "f(x)", value: "exp(-x^2/2) * cos(3x)"})
  view.classList.add("ojs-fill")
  return view
}
```
```{ojs}
viewof rowMethod = {
  const view = Inputs.select(["trapezoid", "Simpson", "Gauss"], {label: "rule"})
  view.classList.add("ojs-auto")
  return view
}
```
```{ojs}
viewof rowReset = {
  const view = Inputs.button("Reset")
  view.classList.add("ojs-end")
  return view
}
```
:::

## A grid of every input

`ojs-grid` gives equal columns, as many as fit. Each kind of control shares one height and one label size, so the grid lines up on both edges.

::: {.ojs-panel .ojs-grid}
```{ojs}
viewof gridText = Inputs.text({label: "text", value: "x^2"})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridNumber = Inputs.number({label: "number", value: 3})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridRange = Inputs.range([0, 1], {label: "range", step: 0.01, value: 0.5})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridSelect = Inputs.select(["Euler", "RK4", "midpoint"], {label: "select"})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridRadio = Inputs.radio(["sin", "cos"], {label: "radio", value: "sin"})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridCheck = Inputs.checkbox(["error", "exact"], {label: "checkbox", value: ["exact"]})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridToggle = Inputs.toggle({label: "toggle", value: true})
```
```{ojs}
viewof gridButton = Inputs.button("button")
```
:::

## A row with a grid inside

One panel, a bare `ojs-grid` nested in it (never a second panel: the border and background would double up).

::: {.ojs-panel .ojs-row}
```{ojs}
viewof nestedExpr = Inputs.text({label: "g(x)", value: "sin(x)"})
```
::: {.ojs-grid}
```{ojs}
viewof nestedA = Inputs.range([-5, 5], {label: "a", step: 0.1, value: -2})
```
```{ojs}
viewof nestedB = Inputs.range([-5, 5], {label: "b", step: 0.1, value: 2})
```
:::
:::

## A controls bar of sliders

`ojs-chart-controls ojs-grid` above a chart: at most two sliders per row (one on a narrow bar), fluid tracks, compact number fields, each label above its control. Each slider gets ▶; the last one opts out with `data-vm-play="off"`.

::: {.ojs-chart-block}
::: {.ojs-chart-controls .ojs-grid}
```{ojs}
viewof barAmp = Inputs.range([0.1, 2], {label: "amplitude", step: 0.05, value: 1})
```
```{ojs}
viewof barFreq = Inputs.range([0.5, 6], {label: "frequency", step: 0.1, value: 2})
```
```{ojs}
viewof barZoom = {
  // A view setting, not a parameter to sweep: no play button.
  const view = Inputs.range([1, 10], {label: "x range", step: 0.5, value: 6})
  view.setAttribute("data-vm-play", "off")
  return view
}
```
:::
```{ojs}
{
  const xs = [], ys = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 400; i++) {
    const x = -barZoom + 2 * barZoom * i / 400
    xs.push(x); ys.push(barAmp * Math.sin(barFreq * x))
  }
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.style.height = "320px"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [
    {x: xs, y: ys, name: "a sin(fx)", line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 2.5}}
  ], VM.plotting.layout({showlegend: false, yaxis: {range: [-2.2, 2.2]}}), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```
:::
